receiver_requirements: Verify the raw bundle SHA-256 before import.
Ensure the pinned parent exists from public main history; this is an incremental bundle.
Use a separate temporary repository or a clean dedicated checkout. Do not reset, clean, amend or cherry-pick another worktree.
Verify bundle prerequisites, then import its exact branch ref without forcing an existing conflicting branch.
Verify the resulting commit, tree, direct parent, raw commit identity, and approved two-path diff before any push.
Recheck live remote branch and PR state. Existing authorization permits ordinary push of this exact head and creation or reuse of a Draft PR only.
Do not execute code from the bundle. No merge, outreach, Foundry, repair, Capture or new authorization is included.
